headline: Underwriting strength powers a standout quarter
summary_short: AIG's Q1 2026 diluted EPS rose 21.6% y/y to $1.41 as General Insurance underwriting income more than tripled to $774M and the combined ratio improved 850bp to 87.3%, while net income grew 9.3% y/y to $763M.
summary_long: Net income rose 9.3% y/y to $763M ($1.41 diluted EPS, +21.6%) as General Insurance underwriting income jumped 219% to $774M on a lower 3.0-point catastrophe load and $132M of favorable prior-year reserve development, pulling the combined ratio in 850bp to 87.3%. Net premiums written grew 24% y/y (18% constant-dollar) across all three segments. Adjusted after-tax income per share rose 80% to $2.11. AIG returned $760M to shareholders ($519M buybacks, $241M dividends) and raised its quarterly dividend 11% to $0.50/share starting Q2. Shareholders' equity fell 1.8% q/q to $40.4B on the capital returns. No new numeric guidance was issued; management reaffirmed its 2025 Investor Day targets qualitatively.
